iterations.verdict: Selected after actual comparison with own correctly paletted body1 and enlarged catalogue/all41 updates. Retains low broad square grey-blue base, compact paler angular central block with sloping shoulder, characteristic split red face including tapered upper-right field, two pale upper rails flanking one shorter brass bar, short rear pale stub/front brass stud, right brass two-port plaque/separate upright, four base channels/end bays, front three-point field and two brass corner rails.
